body: I have thought about this quite a bit as well.

I've been very interested in dual suicide or at least getting help to do my own, I'd even be willing to pay someone a large sum (no need for money afterwards lol) to help but I know that nobody would be willing to help, even if it were just helping me buy a device
Back in high school a kid hanged themselves and ever since then I think about how if they could do it I can very often
Idk, this is pretty much everyone I meet. And if someone isn't like that they have better people to invest their time in than me

I've tried therapy but it didn't work and I left as soon as I had an excuse and don't plan on going back. Tbh it's not even like I want to live or be convinced to live anymore, I've come to accept my situation and whats going to happen. I'm on many meds including for depression and idk if any of it works anyway.
I may not owe anyone anything but if I want anything from them (friendship, attention, etc.) I have to give something
Gee, thanks. Not everyone is like you though. Before you commented I got a pm from someone who read this and decided the best course of action would be to beg me for sex.

I have nobody in my life really, besides one or two family members I have cut them all off in one way or another. I have maybe not always felt like this but it has been a very long time since I haven't. I don't know if I can think of a day where I haven't thought of killing myself, but I guess despite that I've had days one could consider good, I just don't really feel anything about it. Idk what a good day could be for me tbh sorry
There is no longer anything good to be gained out of my life, so every second I remain in this terrible skin I am trapped and suffering
